title: interactive questions max 7 same place
rule: Interactive questions: ≤7; one at a time in the same place. Written to “you”; choices immediately under the question as answers; Continue/context-specific button (not “Next” if the page already has Next in multi-page nav); always a way back (“change your selection”). Dual-cite GOV.UK one-question-per-page (Canada keeps subsequent questions on the same page in the same slot). Pre-select most-common vs GOV.UK do-not-preselect is not a NEW row.
pass_when: ≤7 questions, one visible at a time in the same slot; you-voice; choices as answers under the question; Continue is not a conflicting “Next”; a way back exists.
fail_when: Many questions shown at once; “Next” clashes with page Next; no way to change a selection.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A winner vs GOV.UK one-question-per-page; a NEW pre-select rule.
